Warren County Fiscal Court Agenda
Thursday, October 15, 2026 | 9:00 AM
1. Invocation
2. Pledge to the flag
3. Roll call
4. Approve minutes of the fiscal court meeting on September 24, 2026 and special-called
fiscal court meeting on September 29, 2026.
5. Approve personnel changes for Warren County.
6. Approve work schedule for the Warren County Road Department.
7. Approve second and final reading of Ordinance #26-22WC Adopting an Animal Control
Policy in Warren County.
8. Warren County Regional Jail Canteen Account financial report for August 2026.
9. Approve Memorandum of Agreement between the Kentucky Division of Emergency
Management and Warren County Fiscal Court for the 2026 Rescue Aid Fund Grant in the
amount of $13,022.77 and authorize Judge Executive to execute all related documents.
10. Grant Judge Executive authority to execute 2027 Litter Abatement Grant funding
application and all related documents.
11. Approve determination in the amount of $5,500.80 to KACo for addition of SKYPAC
Annex Building to the County’s Insurance. (Contracted Vendor)
12. Accept quarterly financial reports from Alvaton, Browning, Gott, and Smiths Grove Fire
Departments.
13. Approve reimbursement to the County Clerk in the amount of $8,742.15 for preparation
of the 2025 Real Estate Property Tax bills.
14. Approve Interfund Transfers for Warren County.
15. Authorize Judge Executive to execute Service Agreement with Living Hope Baptist
Church for use of gym space for the upcoming 2026-2027 youth basketball league.
16. Approve Order #26-40 Declaring Surplus Equipment for the Department of Public Safety.
17. Approve Order #26-41 Declaring Surplus Equipment for Parks and Rec.
18. Approve 211 Report for September 2026.
19. Approve Order #26-42 Appointing Jim Page to the Bowling Green ITA Board of Directors.
20. Approve determination in the amount of $47,922.00 to Freedom Dodge of Lexington for
a 2027 RAM 1500 Crew CAB for Drug Taskforce. (State Price Contract)
21. Approve first reading of Ordinance #26-23 Relating to the Annual Budget and
Amendment Thereof.
22. Approve budget transfers for Warren County.
23. Accept bid from Caveland Environmental in the amount of $121,380 for a 24-month
agreement for portable toilets and wash stations for Parks and Rec. (Publicly advertised.
Only bid received.)
24. Accept bid from Clark Beverage Group for a 24-month agreement for vending machines
with 30% of gross profit being returned to Parks. (Publicly advertised. Only bid
received.)
25. Approve determination in the amount of $12,392.66 to Atek Electric and Mechanical for
lighting installation for the parking structure. (Three quotes requested. Two received.
Lowest and best.)
26. Approve determination in the amount of $8,039.10 to CED Bowling Green for purchase
of light fixtures for the parking structure. (Three quotes requested. Two received.
Lowest and best.)
27. Approve Order #26-43 Appointing Jim Page to the South Central Kentucky Regional
Development Authority (RDA).
28. Approve Order #26-44 Appointing Members to the Fire Department Executive Steering
Committee.
29. Grant Judge Executive authority to execute the Statewide Emergency Management
Mutal Aid and Assistance Agreement with the Commonwealth of Kentucky.
30. Approve first reading of Ordinance #26-24WC Authorizing a Lighting Agreement
Between Warren Rural Electric Cooperative Corporation and Bridleton Farms
Subdivision.
31. Claims
Department Heads
Brett Hightower, Sheriff

32. Adjourn
